meta.title: Long-Running Stability & Memory Monitoring
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create stress tests that run for 24-48 hours continuously to validate long-term stability and detect memory leaks.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: 24-hour stability test passes: responsive throughout, no crashes
Memory growth less than 10% over 24 hours, sampled hourly
State remains consistent (positions tracked, calculations verified periodically)
Stability report generated with runtime, memory snapshots, order count, errors, pass/fail

architecture-context.pattern: Use tracemalloc to sample memory hourly. Calculate growth percentage. Detect exponential vs linear growth.
